description: Search live jobs where the employer has published an annual base salary of $100,000 or more. Returns up to 25 jobs per call with pay range, location, employer and sixfigurework.com URLs to cite. Not the whole labor market: only employer-published $100K+ base.

category.description: Job family id or name, e.g. software_engineering or 'Finance & Accounting'. See list_filters.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call with the same filters.

metro.description: Metro area id or name, e.g. 'new-york-ny' or 'Denver'. See list_filters.

min_salary.description: Only jobs whose published base minimum is at least this many dollars.

q.description: Free-text search over titles and descriptions, e.g. 'staff data engineer'.

seniority.description: entry, mid, senior, staff_principal, manager, director, vp_exec, intern, unknown.

sort.description: Default: relevance when q is set, else highest_min.

state.description: US state code or name, e.g. 'ca' or 'California'.

name: search_jobs
title: Search six-figure jobs
